Tarikh | Episode 1019 | 11 July 2025
Marathi's roots are in Maharashtri Prakrit, with its oldest known record from 983 CE in Shravanabelagola.
The Bhakti movement, especially Sant Dnyaneshwar's 'Dnyaneshwari,' significantly shaped Marathi literature.
Shivaji Maharaj promoted Marathi in administration as a political statement against Mughal influence.
Post-independence, linguistic reorganization led to Maharashtra's formation with Marathi as its official language.
Shiv Sena, under Bal Thackeray, politicized Marathi pride, leading to conflicts against non-Marathi speakers.
